body:
Monday morning: two workers from the seed trial carried an oily film. my eyes began burning before the county van arrived.

I meant to ask about it in the morning. By then the person who could answer had gone with the last vehicle, and this was all that remained.

Perhaps the new instructions were meant to help us. They arrived after we had already followed the old ones.
title: Monday morning — an oily film
gloss: A personal trace connects a farm trial to symptoms before a later restriction.
rival_reading: Emergency workers could have picked up the same an oily film while responding near a field; this personal trace does not prove the trial caused the emergency.
